exact_statement: For every n>=1 and x0 in the uniform sign cube, f=1-2 indicator{x=x0} has d_i=2^(1-n)=d for every coordinate, H_n=-2(1-d)^2 log2(1-d)-2d(2-d)log2(d), and D_i/d=(H_n-H_(n-1)/2)/d. These rates are 0 at n=1, 4 at n=2, strictly decrease for n>=3 and tend to 4, with sharp supremum R_3=12-(9/2)log2(3). The log-charge rate is L_n=lambda_i/d=1-d+d log2((1-2d+2d^2)/d^2); its sharp supremum is L_3=L_4=(3+log2(10))/4, it strictly decreases for n>=4 and tends to 1. KL_2(nu_i||q_i)=n-1-L_n. Every nonconstant physical descendant is a point function; therefore R_3 I(g_t)-H(g_t) is a supermartingale for every fair adaptive fresh-coordinate policy on this family, and the minimal nonnegative reserve Q* with zero constant-leaf boundary is identically zero at every C>=R_3. The drift price R_3 is sharp for this class.
hypotheses: uniform finite cube and Boolean sign output
n>=1; pure one-point defect, translated vertices allowed
entropy and KL in bits; normalized Fourier coefficients
nu_i=b_T^2/d_i, q_i=a_T^2+b_T^2 and lambda_i=sum b_T^2 log2(q_i/b_T^2)
fair adaptive policy queries fresh coordinates using only physical history and independent policy seed
Q*_v=max(0,D_v-Cd_v+average Q*_children), zero at constant leaves
